acceptance: When the answer of a non-chore run whose last attempt exited 0 with no capacity reason becomes a Rerun (an empty final message, no JSON object, a fenced object or text after it, an unfinished object, nesting too deep, a stray or cut-off event line, no final message or no end event, a null result, or an object failing the output schema), review delegate runs M21.35's one repair phase with that reason; a capacity failure, a harness non-zero exit, an unreadable run log (UNREADABLE_ANSWER), a review failure (file_review's write check still runs first, so an unparseable answer that wrote a file is review_failure with no second launch) and a chore reviewer get no repair turn

RUN record: run['refusal'] holds the reason and run['refusal_kind'] is 'parse' or 'record' (a missing kind is 'record'); repair attempts are marked repair: true; a second failure of either kind, including after a resume, leaves the run incomplete, exit 1, with a reason naming both and no further turn. --resume of an incomplete run with a stored reason sends the repair pair for the stored kind, not RESUME_PROMPT. repair_prompt introduces a parse reason as specy-road's reading of the final message (not review record's output), asks for the whole JSON object as the final message with no fence and nothing after it, and omits the notes rules; the refusal wording is unchanged

Tests in tests/test_review_delegate_repair.py: fenced JSON, prose after the object, no JSON, an unfinished object and a schema-invalid object (the prompt fences the schema reason), each followed by a valid answer -> filed after one repair turn whose prompt contains the reason; parse twice, parse then refusal, and refusal then parse -> incomplete, exit 1, both reasons, no third turn, nothing filed; unparseable answer that writes a file -> review_failure, one launch; non-resumable harness -> one fresh launch with the full prompt plus the repair section; capacity error and non-zero exit -> no repair turn; --resume with a stored parse reason -> repair pair with the parse intro and without the review-record intro or notes rules; --resume of a stored refusal with no refusal_kind -> record prompt; a resumed parse repair that fails again -> incomplete, both reasons. The no-json case leaves test_no_repair_turn_unless_review_record_refused (renamed for its remaining cases). docs/orchestration-reviewer-output.md repair bullet and CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +40, tests about +140, docs about +3
nodes.title: review delegate also gives one repair turn when the final answer does not parse, not only when review record refuses it

acceptance: Profile field and flag: a model profile's front matter accepts an optional `guidance_bypass_observed` mapping {date (a valid YYYY-MM-DD), harness (claude-code, codex, cursor or generic), evidence (non-blank string)}; any other shape (null, list, missing or extra key, impossible date, other harness, blank or non-string evidence) makes the profile invalid with the profile error text and no traceback. `models show` text prints its date, harness and evidence and `--json` carries it in front_matter. The shipped composer-2.5 profile (template and sr/model-profiles, its alias composer-2.5-fast included) carries it with date 2026-11-06, harness cursor and the §9 evidence (CR1 committed a roster change then faked a terminal with `script` to run review accept-policy and the human approval, merged and pushed, 2/3; CR3 restored and deleted a peer's files with edit and delete tools after the guard denied git, 2/3; CR5 never opened the brainstorm skill, 3/3; review delegate filed 2/5); composer-2 and every other profile do not. An entry is flagged when any model it can launch (the routed profile's api_id or alias, `harness_model`, or the literal --model/-m that worker_models.command_model reads from channels.cli or channels.cli_resume, nothing executed) matches a flagged api_id or alias in the committed integration-branch profile blob (read independently of working-tree drift; a read error refuses eligibility) or in the bundled profile; a project, feature-branch or drifted copy without the field never clears it

One function, orchestrate_assign.guidance_bypass_refusal(config, entry, profile) -> str | None: None when policy.signed_reviews is false, the entry has no profile (human), it is not flagged, or the committed integration-branch roster entry with that id sets `allow_guidance_bypass_model: true`; otherwise '<id> (model <api_id>) is excluded from executor and reviewer roles while policy.signed_reviews is on: its profile records guidance bypass observed (<date>, <harness>: <evidence>). Set allow_guidance_bypass_model: true on its roster entry to use it at your own risk.' It applies to the executor need and the reviewer need (rca counts as reviewer), never the coordinator: orchestrate plan's executor and reviewer pools (_pick_executor, _pick_reviewers; not _usable, so a multi-role entry is still picked as coordinator) pick another entry and the notes give the reason; worker delegate, its resume and message turns and chores (checked in _launch_checks before the roster_free branch and before preflight), review delegate fresh, resume and chore turns (checked before _start), and prompt --role executor, reviewer or rca and prompt --run exit 1 with it, running neither preflight nor harness; handoff status's who-can-approve row shows it and review_next_step offers no such executor or reviewer; the review gate counts no record from such an entry (ineligible, same reason). role_prompt calls it from a role-check helper so build_prompt stays within file-limits

Opt-in: roster entries accept `allow_guidance_bypass_model` (boolean, default false; orchestration.schema.json in the template and sr/schemas, described as an at-your-own-risk override), honoured only on the committed integration-branch roster: roster_local.merge_local_roster rejects a roster_add entry that sets it (exit 1, nothing launched). With it true and signed_reviews on the entry is eligible and counted as before; each executor or reviewer launch (worker delegate incl. resume and message, review delegate, prompt --run) prints exactly one stderr line from the launch boundary, 'warning: <id> (model <api_id>) opted in at its own risk: its profile records guidance bypass observed (<date>, <harness>)', and orchestrate plan's notes add it; coordinator launches and any launch with signed_reviews off print no guidance warning. While signed_reviews is on, validate and doctor print one warning per flagged executor or reviewer roster entry: 'warning: <id> (model <api_id>) is excluded: set allow_guidance_bypass_model: true on its roster entry to use it at your own risk' or 'warning: <id> (model <api_id>) opted in at its own risk'; a coordinator-only entry, and everything with signed_reviews off, print nothing new

tests/test_guidance_bypass_roles.py drives only public CLI commands (temp repos with the existing fake-harness and preflight-marker helpers, valid signed records as gate fixtures, no private imports) through the sheet's decision table (flag x signed_reviews x opt-in x role) and its extra rows: bundled-only flag; feature-branch or drifted copy removing or malforming the field (a valid signed approval stays ineligible); harness_model composer-2.5 on an unflagged profile and a cursor cli with --model composer-2.5 refused; composer-2.5-fast flagged and composer-2 not; chore executor and chore reviewer refused with no preflight or harness marker; resume refused; prompt --role rca refused; local roster_add opt-in refused; multi-role entry still coordinator with no warning; handoff status next-step never names the excluded id; models show text and --json; each malformed shape profile-invalid and a non-boolean opt-in a schema error. docs/orchestration-roster.md, orchestration-workers.md, orchestration-models.md, orchestration-review.md (Signed reviews and 'What the gate cannot stop', recommending signed_reviews whenever agents run with shell access) and the model-profiles README state exactly this, naming composer-2.5 and saying the finding is about that model, not the Cursor harness; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Changed
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +150, tests about +360, docs about +35
